name: Prepare carrier and messaging fields for CRM contacts with QuietPass

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({sourceId: $("Example contact").item.json.sourceId, phone: $json.number.e164, requestId: $json.requestId, ...($json.number.carrier == null ? {} : {carrier: $json.number.carrier}), ...($json.contact.whatsapp.registered == null ? {} : {whatsappRegistered: $json.contact.whatsapp.registered}), ...($json.contact.telegram.registered == null ? {} : {telegramRegistered: $json.contact.telegram.registered}), ...($json.contact.sms.supported == null ? {} : {smsSupported: $json.contact.sms.supported, smsAssumed: $json.contact.sms.assumed})}) }}

parameters.content:
## Prepare contact intelligence with a spending cap
Use this template to prepare carrier, SMS-support, and messaging-registration fields for contact enrichment. It starts with fictional data and does not write to a CRM or send messages.

### How it works
QuietPass first returns a free quote for the selected checks. The next node submits the original quote, ceiling, currency, and event key. Paid execution is deliberately OFF, so the initial rehearsal stops before spending credit. Once deliberately enabled, the final step prepares contact fields while preserving definite false answers and omitting unavailable values. App registration and SMS support do not guarantee message delivery, ownership, or consent.

### Setup
Install n8n-nodes-quietpass on a compatible self-hosted instance while n8n verification is pending. Create a QuietPass account with activated credit and a server API key. Select its QuietPass API credential in both QuietPass nodes. Replace the fictional contact with an authorized number, confirm GBP matches your workspace, and review the 0.05 per-number and run ceilings before enabling Allow Live Lookup. Manual execution then spends real credit.

Use stable source event IDs for changed numbers. Save original operation references durably before execution in production. Recover interrupted requests using the original quote; do not requote blindly or insert delays. Connect prepared output to your CRM only after reviewing the mapping.

## Prepare source contacts
Replace fictional input with your authorized source.

## Quote and prepare enrichment
Review the quote and spending caps. Paid execution is OFF by default.
